feature_set: Causal frame-0 relative ball x, y, incoming vx only; no parent future collision, actor outcome, seed identity or lane index
label: Relative harm: 0.8 clean foot but 1.2 nonfoot, or 0.8 <=4m excursion but 1.2 >4m excursion
models: decision tree max_depth=3 min_samples_leaf=2 class_weight={0:1,1:4} random_state=0
random forest n_estimators=100 max_depth=4 min_samples_leaf=2 class_weight={0:1,1:4} random_state=0
standardized logistic regression C=0.1 class_weight={0:1,1:4} max_iter=1000 random_state=0
validation: Leave-one-seed-out across all 81 consumed courses; compare true risk recall, safe vetoes, selected high-quality and clean-foot retention. A zero-false-negative CV is necessary but not sufficient; model family selection on CV consumes this validation and requires a new sealed physical exam.
gate: No policy export or motor change if any held-out risk is missed, any held-out newly unsafe course is selected, or source/audit mismatch. Even a passing development model is only eligible for a new SIM_ONLY physical exam, never a real robot or promotional video.
